scope: Selected raw synthetic measurement folders; the baseline and first implementation snapshot belong to their own69-module source snapshots, not the post-adoption inventory. Source bindings inside each report remain authoritative. Original payload bytes retained; private key files, generated Git hooks and caches omitted. Tar owner metadata normalized to uid/gid 0 with empty owner names; archive paths are relative to benchmarks/results. Prior attempts retained separately. No operator credentials or human labels.
